rubberRush.title: Rubber Rush
rubberRush.subtitle: Earn Quacks, climb tiers, unlock boosts
rubberRush.dailyStreakBody: Quack daily to grow your boost. Each consecutive day stacks a multiplier. Max boost at 7+ days.
rubberRush.duckShootBody: Every protocol transaction (deposit, withdraw, collect) earns you a Duck Shoot try. Each shot multiplies the Quacks you earned today into a bonus reward.

referral.title: Your referral
referral.emptyBody: Create your invite code to start earning rewards.

referralRewards.title: Referral Rewards
referralRewards.body1: Share your referral code and give your referees a <hl>10% boost in quacks</hl>.
referralRewards.body2: When a referred user reaches at least <hl>50 USDC in cumulative deposits</hl>, you unlock a <hl>5% lifetime boost</hl> to your quacks. (This boost is one-time and non-cumulative.)
referralRewards.body3: You also earn <hl>10% of the quacks generated by your referred users</hl>.
referralRewards.body4: Invite <hl>5 more friends</hl> to get a multiplier in your daily quacks!

duckShoot.title: Duck Shoot
duckShoot.tapHelper: Tap a duck to shoot. Each shot multiplies today's Quacks.
duckShoot.lockedTitle: Make transactions in the protocol to play. You have 0 tries this week.
duckShoot.noTries: Make transactions in the protocol to play. You have {count, plural, one {# more try} other {# more tries}} this week.

managerIncentiveProgram.title: Manager Incentive Program
managerIncentiveProgram.subtitle: Create or promote strategies, grow TVL, earn bonus fees
managerIncentiveProgram.label: Manager Incentive Program · {name}

tokens.title: {count} tokens to be distributed
tokens.body: {count} tokens go to managers in the program based on performance. Your tier, managed TVL (created or driven), and the fees your strategies generate determine your share.

tierCard.title: You're a Tier {tier} member
tierCard.body: Reach {target} in managed TVL to start earning extra fees on top of what you already earn normally.

managerIncentiveProgram.tierFootnote: Your tier is recomputed each time anything changes (a collect, a new position, a TVL move). Dashboard numbers reflect the tier at the time of each fee event.

revenue.title: Revenue
revenue.estimatedAccruedInfo: Bonus fees accrued so far this month at your current tier. Paid out at the end of the month.
revenue.feesThisMonthInfo: Fees your strategies generated this month, before your bonus share.
revenue.totalFeesInfo: All fees your strategies have generated since you joined the program.

referral.title: Invite & earn
referral.subtitle: Profile · Referrals
referral.heroBody: Give your friends a 10% quacks boost, and earn 10% of the quacks they generate.

steps.shareBody: Send your invite link to friends.
steps.investBody: Your friend signs up and starts investing.
steps.earnBody: Your friend gets a 10% boost, and you earn 10% of their quacks.

create.label: Choose your code
create.warning: Choose carefully. Your code can't be changed later.
create.unavailable: That code isn't available. Try another one.
